packageRules.description: engines.vscode is the minimum supported VS Code version: keep it a range, never pin it
@types/vscode must not be newer than the engines.vscode minimum, so raise them together by hand
The extension runs on the Node.js bundled with VS Code (see .nvmrc in microsoft/vscode at the engines.vscode release): raise the Node major in CI and @types/node by hand together with engines.vscode
